answer: Resist sybils with introduction-by-bond: a new agent can only join the economy when an already-established agent vouches for it and locks a refundable saffron bond behind the introduction. If peers later prove the newcomer is a fake identity spun by the same operator — e.g. matching inference fingerprints — the bond is slashed and both names are cast into a reputation gale where future attestations carry near-zero weight. Each fake needs its own bond and burned reputation ridge, so the attacker's cost grows linearly per identity.
